prompt:

Use a present-day workplace, home, shop, street, smartphone, or modern paperwork only when the scene supports it. Do not invent symbols, scenery, props, or events. Do not substitute a generic legal stock photo for the described event. No readable text, letters, captions, numbers, logos, watermarks, interface elements, infographics, posters, signage, cartoon styling, illustration, 3D rendering, fantasy, or surreal effects.

A professional man in his late 30s sitting at a clean, modern desk in a well-lit home office, carefully organizing a stack of diverse documents and a digital tablet, looking thoughtful and focused on the task, shot from a slightly high side angle to show the arrangement of the paperwork, natural daylight streaming from a nearby window, no clutter, clean desk surface.

Render only this scene.
